delete-buffer.description: Delete a paste buffer. From a pane this needs the write grant, and a pane without admin may delete only its own buffers.

params.name: name
params.description: The buffer to delete. Omit for the newest buffer tuios named, as tmux does: for the person, the newest of the person's own, and for a pane without admin, the newest of its own.

params.name: version
params.description: Act only while the buffer holds the content of this version, as list-buffers or show-buffer gave it. Otherwise the call answers no_buffer.

returns.name: name
returns.description: The buffer that was deleted.

list-buffers.description: List the paste buffers, newest first. A yank in copy mode adds one, and so does set-buffer. From a pane this needs the read grant, and a pane without admin sees only the buffers it set. Every total counts only the buffers listed.

params.name: sample_width
params.description: How many characters each sample shows, at most 200.

returns.name: buffers
returns.description: One entry per buffer, newest first: name, bytes, created, automatic, sample, session, pane.

returns.name: total
returns.description: How many buffers there are.

returns.name: bytes
returns.description: How many bytes they hold together.

returns.name: limit
returns.description: How many buffers the daemon keeps, from [paste_buffers] limit.

returns.name: max_bytes
returns.description: How many bytes the buffers may hold together, from [paste_buffers] max_kb.

paste-buffer.description: Type a paste buffer into a window's PTY as a paste. Each line feed becomes a carriage return unless raw, as in tmux. Control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return are removed, and the text is wrapped in the bracketed paste delimiters when the program in the pane turned bracketed paste on. From a pane this needs the read and write grants.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: window
params.description: Window id or name. Omit to target the focused window.

params.name: name
params.description: The buffer to paste. Omit for the newest buffer tuios named, as tmux does: for the person, the newest of the person's own, and for a pane without admin, the newest of its own.

params.name: delete
params.description: Delete the buffer after the paste, unless its content was set again meanwhile.

params.name: raw
params.description: Keep each line feed instead of turning it into a carriage return.

params.name: version
params.description: Act only while the buffer holds the content of this version, as list-buffers or show-buffer gave it. Otherwise the call answers no_buffer.

params.name: allow_blocked
params.description: From a pane, type into a pane on needs_input instead of refusing with agent_blocked. What is typed then answers its prompt, which also needs the respond grant. The person, outside every pane, is not held.

returns.name: name
returns.description: The buffer that was pasted.

returns.name: bytes
returns.description: How many bytes the buffer holds.

returns.name: bracketed
returns.description: True when the paste went in the bracketed paste delimiters.

returns.name: deleted
returns.description: True when the buffer was deleted after the paste.

set-buffer.description: Store content in a paste buffer and put it on top. With no name a new buffer is made, append or not, as tmux does; a name makes the buffer a named one. Empty content stores nothing and is no error. When the buffers tuios named pass the limit, the oldest of them go; past the byte cap the oldest go whatever their name. A set from outside every pane, or from a pane with admin, makes the person's buffer; a set from a pane without admin makes that pane's own. From a pane this needs the write grant, and a pane without admin may set only its own buffers, or make a new one with no name.

params.name: data
params.description: The content as text. Give data or data_b64. It may not be empty or larger than the byte cap.

params.name: data_b64
params.description: The content as base64, for any bytes. It wins over data.

params.name: upload
params.description: An id that sends the content in parts, each in its own call on one connection. The buffer is set once, when the part without more arrives.

params.name: more
params.description: More parts of this upload follow.

params.name: name
params.description: The buffer to set: 1 to 64 printable characters. Omit for a new buffer.

params.name: append
params.description: Add the text to the end of the buffer instead of replacing it.

returns.name: name
returns.description: The buffer's name: bufferN for one tuios named, or the name set-buffer gave it.

returns.name: bytes
returns.description: How many bytes the buffer holds.

returns.name: created
returns.description: Unix-nano time the content was last set.

returns.name: version
returns.description: A number that changes each time the content is set. Pass it back as version to act only on this content.

returns.name: automatic
returns.description: True when tuios named the buffer.

returns.name: sample
returns.description: The start of the content on one line, with control characters and bytes that are not UTF-8 shown as escapes. It never cuts a character. Print it as it is.

returns.name: pane
returns.description: The pane that owns the buffer, by its window name, or its short id once it is gone. Absent for the person's buffers.

returns.name: stored
returns.description: False when the content was empty and nothing was stored. The other fields are then absent.

show-buffer.description: Return the content of one paste buffer. A buffer can hold any bytes: data_b64 carries them all, and data carries them as text. From a pane this needs the read grant, and reaches only the buffers of the sessions the pane may read.

params.name: name
params.description: The buffer to show. Omit for the newest buffer tuios named, as tmux does: for the person, the newest of the person's own, and for a pane without admin, the newest of its own.

params.name: version
params.description: Act only while the buffer holds the content of this version, as list-buffers or show-buffer gave it. Otherwise the call answers no_buffer.

params.name: encoding
params.description: base64 to get data_b64 alone, without the text in data.

returns.name: name
returns.description: The buffer's name: bufferN for one tuios named, or the name set-buffer gave it.

returns.name: bytes
returns.description: How many bytes the buffer holds.

returns.name: created
returns.description: Unix-nano time the content was last set.

returns.name: version
returns.description: A number that changes each time the content is set. Pass it back as version to act only on this content.

returns.name: automatic
returns.description: True when tuios named the buffer.

returns.name: sample
returns.description: The start of the content on one line, with control characters and bytes that are not UTF-8 shown as escapes. It never cuts a character. Print it as it is.

returns.name: pane
returns.description: The pane that owns the buffer, by its window name, or its short id once it is gone. Absent for the person's buffers.

returns.name: data
returns.description: The whole content as text. A byte that is not UTF-8 reads as U+FFFD here.

returns.name: data_b64
returns.description: The whole content, every byte, as base64.
